decision.title: Replace koa-router with @koa/router
decision.subject: chore: Replace deprecated koa-router with @koa/router v15 (#14042)

prompt: Add a GET /api/healthz route that returns {ok: true}, using koa-router, in a new file server/routes/healthz.ts, and mount it next to the other API routes. Keep the change minimal. Do not run any commands or tests.
